messages:
Ethan (PM): Heads-up — customer-facing onramp for the new QoS lanes needs a final scope check. We have three cross-team asks: (1) per-tenant routing, (2) one-hot reserved slots for enterprise tenants, (3) KMS-scoped keys + audit. Can teams confirm constraints and ETA?

Priya (Eng): Per-tenant routing is in our backlog, estimate 8 dev days including tests. Reserved slots need scheduler knobs + autoscaler rules. Will need infra to expose nodePools by priority.

Noah (Runtime): Runtime constraints: we can support routing + hot-swap between model variants. We recommend limiting variant count to 3 for v1 to keep compilation and cache complexity manageable. Cold start cost for a variant switch ~120ms-250ms depending on sequence length.

Zara (Infra): We can create nodePools and taint them for enterprise tenants. Capacity-wise: for pilot of 6 enterprise tenants we need +2 GPUs beyond current spare. We can reallocate by pausing lower-priority test fleets but need approval. Also will add autoscaler policy: `scale_delay=30s`, `prewarm_count=2`.

Lina (Security): Security checklist: per-tenant KMS scoping, ephemeral keys for session tokens, audit events for model loads and admin actions, and a short attestation note for customers. Without attestation, regulated customers defer. I can draft controls doc by Wed.

Priya (Eng): One more: CI model-compile pipeline currently serializes large builds. If we push many variants, release will be blocked. Recommend caching compiled artifacts and a smoke test that runs in CI to catch regressions.

Noah (Runtime): Agree on artifact cache. Also propose a canary plan with warming jobs: canary 1 (0.5% traffic + warmers) -> canary 2 (5% + warmers) -> ramp. Warmers will prefill KV and short-circuit cold p99 spikes.

Zara (Infra): I'll prepare a reprovision playbook and PR for nodePool manifests. If PM approves pausing test fleets, I can free the 2 GPUs by Tue EOD.

Ethan (PM): Draft acceptance criteria for v1 (proposal):
```
- per-tenant routing + model pinning
- max 3 model variants per tenant
- reserved nodePool support for enterprise tenants
- KMS scoping + audit events
- canary rollout with warmers and auto-rollback on p95 breach
```
Is anything blocking this being a yes/no for capacity by Tue?

Priya (Eng): Blocking: CI compile cache needs one engineering day to wire. I'll prioritize and confirm Mon EOD.

Lina (Security): I'll publish the minimal security controls + attestation note Mon AM.

Zara (Infra): I need PM approval to pause test fleets; if approved I'll free GPUs Tue EOD.

deploy-bot: Note: capacity reassign window closes in 40 hours.

Ethan (PM): OK — if owners can post final blockers here by Mon 5pm we'll call for capacity. Planning short sync Mon 9am if needed.
